x: The most outstanding achievements for our track and field season were the performance of our two outstanding high jumpers - Stanley and Sean.
The first mishap occurred just before takeoff when Stanley realised that he had forgotten his passport. He had to return home to collect it and unfortunately missed the plane.
As for high jumpers Stanley and Sean, mentioned elsewhere, they placed at 3rd and 7th in the UK Junior lists and 1st and 2nd in their correct, Youth, age group.
